practical_core.selection: Top-5 by component_local_habitat_score after known-location filtering; identical plant and animal rule

cohort.sampling_rule: for every fixed Japanese region cell x plant/animal x within-frame record-count quartile, sample exactly two previously unused species; no substitution across cells/strata and no replacement after declaration

outer_validation.candidate_generation: build_automatic_discover_bundle(..., candidate_generation_only=True) using training occurrences only
outer_validation.candidate_scoring: integrated_candidate_scores(..., exclude_occurrence_derived=True) to construct auditable components; practical selector reads only component_local_habitat_score
outer_validation.failure_rule: declared pair/fold failures remain in intention-to-evaluate denominator as zero for operational methods; taxa are never replaced after cohort freeze

grts.frame: identical finite ACSP candidate rows after training-only generation and known-location exclusion
grts.recovery_estimand: mean Top-5 held-out recovery over 50 predeclared GRTS draws per fold
grts.mindis_failure_handling: retain official grts output and warning/audit; do not tune mindis or rerun with a favorable threshold

fitted_sdm.implementation: unchanged production-aligned fitted-SDM Top-5 contract from validation/sdm_topk_protocol.json
fitted_sdm.report: mean recall difference, pair interval, sign-flip p, and selected-set overlap/Jaccard with Practical Core
fitted_sdm.interpretation: used to distinguish a finite occurrence-conditioned survey decision from suitability ranking; not required to be inferior for ACSP to be useful

inference.superiority_gate: mean difference >= 0.015 AND pair-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND sign-flip p < 0.05
inference.claim_rule: same-pool superiority is not claimed unless the primary GRTS gate passes on the complete untouched cohort; negative/equivalent results are retained and no retuning is permitted

cohort_size_rationale.reason_for_192_pairs: balanced factorial design across 12 fixed region cells x 2 taxon groups x 4 record-count strata x 2 taxa; kept unchanged after the failed v2 development because no new confirmation taxa have been sampled
cohort_size_rationale.power_caution: paired variance against official GRTS is unknown before confirmation; 192 is retained for balance and sensitivity rather than justified by post-outcome GRTS variance

biosurvey_end_to_end.reason: biosurvey natively selects from a region and environmental raster master matrix, not an arbitrary ACSP finite candidate frame
biosurvey_end_to_end.claim_boundary: passing the same-pool GRTS gate supports superiority only within the ACSP candidate universe; a broader tool-level superiority claim additionally requires the predeclared native biosurvey end-to-end comparison

prospective_field_gate.required_for: claims about access, detection probability, discoveries per field day, route efficiency, or replacement-site utility

leakage_guardrail: held-out coordinates and outcomes are attached only after every operational selection for that fold is frozen; no method may use held-out recovery as an inference-time feature
